judge.say: The cup on the right is cut by the edge of the text panel: shift the crop or move the cup left in the still life.
The headline fills only the top of the panel's middle band and the panel feels empty below the call to action; a larger headline would use the space.
The logo placeholder is a dashed square in the corner: fine as a stand-in, but the piece is not final until the real logo is dropped in.
The image answers the headline: one jar of amber tea, no people, daylight, and the panel does not cover any of it.
